static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系出现紧张；有少数亲密朋友但not愿讨论写作not安
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理治疗或精神科治疗经历；not yet曾出现类似的Self-doubt问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑较好、配合度高，语气谨慎；能识do not并描述自动化思维，Willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己是一个糟糕的写作者，因为我的上一部爱情小说反响not佳，这导致了Self-doubt和without能感。
basic_info.core_demands: Negative feedback has significantly affected my self-esteem and enthusiasm for writing, prompting me to seek counseling support; I want to come out of it and enjoy writing again.
growth_experiences: 六个月前，上一部爱情小说收到主要为负面的反馈，集中在情节和人物Shaping方面；由于投入了大量时间和热情，该反馈带来强烈的压力与Sense of frustration。从此每当坐下来写作或想到写作生涯时，便迅速产生“I am not good enough/我是坏写作者”的Self-doubt与回避倾向。

special_situations.event: Sits down to start writing or thinks about one's writing career
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one work fails, it proves I am overall a failed writer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少或回避开始写作；通过参加线上课程试图弥补“能力not足”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why bother? It will be as bad as the last one.

special_situations.event: Recalling the negative feedback received on the previous romance novel six months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' evaluations determine my writing worth and ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly concerned with external evaluation, reduces discussing writing with friends to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed the readers; I am just a poor author.

special_situations.event: Communication with friends involves writing or ability topics
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not认可我的写作，就说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避谈论写作、not主动分享作品以避免负面评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果他们not认可我的写作，就说明我not行。

special_situations.event: 一想到写作，便把上一部作品的失败泛化到not yet来所有创作
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure means I will always fail in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops or delays writing to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The last work failed, meaning I am doomed to fail every time.

core_conflict.wish: Longs for works to be liked, hopes to be recognized and have writing ability affirmed
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，担心他人评价伤害自尊
defense_goal: 通过Self-deprecation与回避写作来降低再次失败的风险与Anxiety
Reduces discussing writing with others to avoid criticism and humiliation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share works or discuss writing ability, or when recalling negative feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 对方会像读者一样苛刻地negate我，我会被羞辱（Projection性期待）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: useSelf-deprecation的表达，语气犹疑与自责；降低自我评价，避免直接请求他人反馈或迅速结束相关话题。

manifestations: 上一部作品失败后写作热情下降，感觉写作“have not意义”
The 'why bother' experience when sitting down to write
not愿与朋友讨论写作not安，关系出现紧张

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 谈话中频繁Self-denial（将一次失败等同于“我是坏写作者”）
涉及写作话题时过度谨慎，担心被评价而not愿展开

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Taking readers' negative feedback directly as the sole measure of one's own ability
Believes 'one must write works that everyone likes to count as qualified'

exception_events.target_problem: 当坐下来写作时，来访者通常会立刻Self-denial并因此回避或停止写作。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 就在前几天，他尝试开始写一个新故事，虽然出现负面想法，但并not yet立刻放弃。
exception_events.reason: not同做法：在情绪受挫的情况下仍选择行动，尝试开始而非完全回避。

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对他人评价时，来访者通常会将负面反馈视为对自身价值的全面negate，进而降低写作动力。
exception_events.unique_outcome: Past works received readers' liking and positive feedback, showing he is not always a failure.
exception_events.reason: not同理解：过往成功经验作为证据，支持对自我能力的更为平衡的看法。

positive_force: Once had work liked by readers
Willing to accept counseling and participate in cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
Completed an online writing course with learning gains
Stable work performance, basic life structure present
negative_force: 将一次失败Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking
Excessively relies on external evaluation to determine self-worth
not愿向朋友表达not安导致支持without法有效利用
负面反馈引发的羞愧与Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: 写作情境中的即时Self-denial与回避写作
antecedent: Recalls negative feedback or reader criticism of the last work
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失败过度概括，并将外界评价Introjection为自我价值，形成灾难化与非黑即白认知，为避免再次失败而自我打击
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的失败与负面情绪，短期降低Anxiety与羞愧
target_behavior.consequence: Writer's block、Career development受阻、Low mood、Tense relationships with friends
